Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Regenerative Air Preheater 
 Vertical Inverted 
 BHEL - India
Introduction

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1 required for vertical 
rotary regenerative air pre heater, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Gamal Elsyed 
Osily , reviewed by maintenance manager eng. Sobhey Abdel Haleem, approved by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Ghaffar: general manager of Al-Arish power station.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector
Technical Data
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category
Use safety fence with caution mark surrounding the work area
Wear safety helmet - shoes - gloves ... etc

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tools set
Cleaning fluid, feeler gauge

items: Complete maintenance tools set
Cleaning fluid, feeler gauge

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items: Clean up first the entire heater
Examine the condition of heating element replace if necessary
Repeat half yearly inspection
Replace gland packing
Examine trunnion bolts
Examine rotor post to diaphragm weld

Open pinion cover. Examine pinion and pin rack for wear and proper 
 engagement
Pack all electric motor bearing with first grease
Examine the condition of gears and pinions and bearings
Lubricate all coupling
Examine oil line for cracks damage
Examine cleaning device gear boxes
Check steam blowing nozzle
Check water washing nozzle
Examine the cold end basket if corrosion has damaged the cold end baskets
Check the seal clearance

sections.text: Guide Bearing (fig 1)

items: Open the cover and check whether locking plat bolts
Drain the oil and inspection the roller from the top
Ensure cooling water supply in order
Support bearing during annual overhaul

Check up the level of the support bearing using a motor level of 0.02 
 mm/meter
Drain oil and inspect the roller using light

sections.text: Drive unit maintenance during overhaul (fig 4)

items: Disconnect all electrical supplies
Remove holding dower bolts from auxiliary motor
Disconnect auxiliary motor coupling and remove it
Remove pinion cover
Remove holding down bolts from main motor
Disconnect main motor coupling remove the motor
Remove holding down bolts from gear box
Slide the gear box on to a temporary stand with the help

Support the pinion temporary using wooden block between pinion bolton and 
 gear reducer
Remove the taper lock bush and remove the power

sections.text: Element replacement (fig 3)

items: Remove basket from removal door
Remove basket end plate from one section of the rotor
Remove the cold end baskets one by one by pulling
Load new set of baskets in the same sector
Continue this procedure until finish

sections.text:
Removal and replacement of hot end 
baskets (fig 2)
Open the access door in the duct work
Remove the redial seals
Remove the hot end baskets from one sector though the access door

Replace with new baskets depending upon the condition of the 
elements
Continue this precedure until finished

items: Open the access door in the duct work
Remove the redial seals
Remove the hot end baskets from one sector though the access door

Replace with new baskets depending upon the condition of the 
elements
Continue this precedure until finished

sections.text:
Seal replacement and setting (fig 
5)
Fix aluminum finger tabs at in board and out board of a diaphragm

Move this diaphragm plate under the sealing surface and adjust the 
finger tab to the required seal clearance

Set the channel type straight edge (redial) at a convenient 
location

Move the finger tabs under the straight edge and set the straight 
edge to sit over the tabs firmly clamp the straight edge

Set one radial seal assembly butting the seal leaves with the 
straight edge. move the seal under the same edge of the sealing surface and 
confirm the correctness of the straight edge setting
Then proceed with the installation of the rest of the radial seals

Install outboard radial seal tabs as per radial seal assembly 
drawing excess metal is to be trimmed off to obtain clearance shown and required

V and V1 heators : slings made with a multiple arrangement of flat 
plate, fork type hooks split to interlock over the holding bars and under the 
bracing bars, have been found to be most suitable for balance and safa handing
